report:
Reviewed the complete grouped_observations claim, all four ordinary implementation associations and all three associated tests; no TODO/N/A entries exist. CompileTest stores exactly one observations expectation, checks marker/expectation presence, and compares the independently prepared observations, diagnostics and queries fields. annotations::parse preserves marker kinds and maps stacked comments to their source line; collect reduces targets to a BTreeSet and tests requested kinds using any(), making duplicates idempotent and order immaterial. For each selected row it emits one header, symbol before type, and only requested applicable fields. The source walker enumerates children before parents; collect uses file/end/reverse-start ordering within source-ordered target lines and shares that ordering between symbols and types. Thus grouping uses the same source-tree observation ordering, rather than introducing a separate symbol traversal. Helper implementation associations now include annotation parsing and source traversal so their changes invalidate this review.

symbols_and_types_share_expression_headers visibly asserts one combined path header, two indented fields in symbol/type order, a type-only parent call and no duplicates despite repeating both markers. reverse_marker_order_has_the_same_output asserts the identical exact output when sym precedes ty. Together these exercise nested child-before-parent output as well as deterministic grouping and marker order. unresolved_paths_still_require_error_markers first rejects an unaccounted diagnostic, then asserts exact symbol-only output (no type field), nonempty diagnostic text, a nonempty independently parsed JSON query array, and absence of observation fields in diagnostics and queries. This closes the missing single-field and output-separation evidence without weakening source-error intent. All assertions and fixtures are visible in the annotated functions.

Executed cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test observations (5 passed), cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib unresolved_paths_still_require_error_markers (1 passed), cargo fmt, and cargo build (passed with existing warnings). Source inspection supports the implementation assessment; those executed commands establish only their stated runtime checks. Central post-codegen and Sage sanity review are coordinated separately.
